# Charlotte

> Open-source MCP server that renders web pages into structured, agent-readable
> representations using headless Chromium. It gives an agent the page as
> structure rather than a raw accessibility dump, which is where most of the
> token cost in browser automation goes.

Charlotte runs locally over stdio, or self-hosted as a remote HTTP server via
Docker that clients such as claude.ai can reach over a tunnel. It exposes 43
tools for navigating, observing and interacting with the web.

Structured capabilities, navigation and access policy for this site are
published at https://charlotte-rose.vercel.app/.well-known/agents.json

## Pages

- [Home](https://charlotte-rose.vercel.app/): overview, architecture diagram, key stats and quick start
- [Charlotte vs Playwright MCP](https://charlotte-rose.vercel.app/vs-playwright/): head-to-head comparison with benchmark data from Wikipedia, GitHub, Hacker News and LinkedIn
- [Changelog](https://charlotte-rose.vercel.app/changelog/): release history from v0.1.0 to current
